paper.title_en: SIDIS off a tensor-polarized spin-1 target
paper.abstract_en: The internal structure of spin-1 hadrons, such as the deuteron, offers a unique window into nuclear dynamics inaccessible to spin-1/2 targets. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering (SIDIS) off a tensor-polarized spin-1 target. Within the transverse momentum dependent (TMD) factorization formalism, we derive the general expression for the differential cross section. We calculate the structure functions up to twist-3 accuracy in the parton model, explicitly incorporating both quark-quark and quark-gluon-quark correlations. At tree level, we identify 21 nonvanishing structure functions expressed as convolutions of TMD parton distribution functions (PDFs) and fragmentation functions (FFs). These results establish a comprehensive foundation for future experimental studies at facilities such as JLab and the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC), where precise measurements of the deuteron tensor-polarized structure are expected.
